description: This file defines the IndexDataManager class responsible for translating and streaming index buffers in a Direct3D context within the ANGLE project. It includes functions for index format conversion, buffer management, and handling primitive restart indices.

classes.name: rx::IndexDataManager
classes.description: Manages index buffer translation and streaming for rendering, including format conversion and static buffer management.

methods.name: rx::IndexDataManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IndexDataManager with a buffer factory.

methods.name: rx::prepareIndexData
methods.description: Prepares index data for rendering by translating indices to a supported format and possibly streaming.

methods.name: rx::streamIndexData
methods.description: Streams index data into a buffer and updates translation info.

methods.name: rx::getStreamingIndexBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a streaming index buffer for a specific index type.
